title: Qualify isolated dw.quantities calendar-version NuGet candidate and exact package-only consumer
commitMessage: test: qualify dw.quantities calendar NuGet binary candidate

contribution.summary: Qualify one source-owned dw.quantities NuGet calendar candidate with an independent compiled package-only consumer, using existing federated NuGet APIs without local-feed publication.
contribution.value: Invoke the unchanged RS134 inventory/version preflight before and after the test; pack only dw.quantities with a dynamic PackageVersion, validate actual package and loaded DLL hashes, and execute four exact rational and identity checks.
debtChanges: The source-preview version and previous local archive identities stay immutable; the calendar candidate is dynamically computed, unreserved and unpublished.
Only standalone dw.quantities is qualified; twelve dependent or other Math packages and their binary graph remain separate gates.
Notices, explicit release approval, installed-package rollback, other RIDs and Discovery bindings are not qualified by this candidate.
RS134's immutable source-pinned preflight and receipt remain unchanged; RS135 reuses its read-only executable and the published NuGet package reader.
contribution.nextAction: Review notices, rights, archive identity and binary consumer evidence before a separately authorized immutable NUGET_LOCAL publication gate. Then qualify Math packages in dependency order.
